title: Antiquities of the Jews, Book X, chapter 10, §4 (trans. William Whiston)

verification_log.method: Read Book X ch. 10 §4 in the Gutenberg plain text

Head of gold = Nebuchadnezzar and earlier Babylonian kings; two arms = the government dissolved by two kings; a king from the west armed with brass; an iron government ruling all the earth; Josephus declines to explain the stone because it concerns the future
